title: fix(wire): Wire Contour takes an exit pick
body:
## What changed

Wire Contour takes an exit pick (`picks.exit`), beside its threading point (`picks.start`).

- `PickCapability::Threading` takes a start and an exit. `list_operation_types` and the `edit_operation` schema say so.
- An open run: the cut ends at the end of the run nearest the exit pick. The wire rides the same line on the same side. The walk turns round when the pick names the first end.
- A closed profile: the cut is the automatic cut, all the way round from the threading point. The wire then rides its own kerf on, in the same direction, to the point of the path nearest the pick. It leaves by a straight lead-out to the pick. It does not return to the threading point.
- The exit is a new module, `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/exit.rs`. It runs the existing generator first, then reads the exit. A cut without an exit pick does not enter the module.

Refused by name, never moved:

- An exit pick the same distance from the two ends of an open run.
- An exit pick on the wire path, nearer the profile than the kerf offset, or on the product side (outside a die, inside a punch).
- An exit pick with tabs, skims, a taper, a no-core burnout or a 4-axis cut. The command door refuses the pair, and generation refuses it again.
- An exit pick on a selected DXF chain that is cut on its own arcs.

## Cause

`PickCapability::Threading::takes` accepted the start role only. The command door refused each exit pick on a Wire Contour: "Wire Contour: a exit point is not taken - this kind takes a start point only". The wire generators had no input for an exit.

PR #3871 already moved `WireContourOp.start` into `picks` and reads the old `start` key. This PR adds the parts that the sweep comment on the issue lists as open.

## Where the issue is silent (smallest change chosen)

The decision file `docs/decisions/3332-wire-exit-pick.md` has the reasons.

- Closed profile: the wire rides on in the lap's own direction, as the 2D Contour ring does. It does not take the shorter way.
- Tabs: the issue says "before the tab or the cut-off". This PR refuses an exit pick with tabs by name. Each stretch between tabs and the tab cut-off start from the threading point with the wire threaded. An exit before the cut-off needs a second threading, and the post has no word for it.
- 4-axis: the pair is refused by name, so the sync pair rule holds without a change.
- A start pick on an open run is ignored, as before this PR. This PR does not change it.
- The Wire Contour Geometry tab shows the exit coordinates. The user can set, edit, and clear the draft exit. Apply commits through the command history.

## Tests

Pins (all red before the fix, except the load test):

- `crates/app/tests/wire_post/exit_pick.rs` (in the existing `wire_post` binary):
  - `an_exit_pick_on_an_open_run_ends_the_cut_at_the_end_nearest_the_pick`
  - `an_exit_pick_between_the_ends_of_an_open_run_is_refused_by_name`
  - `an_exit_pick_on_a_closed_profile_leaves_the_cut_at_the_pick`
  - `each_exit_pick_the_wire_cannot_hold_is_refused_by_name`
  - `undo_and_redo_restore_the_path_of_an_exit_pick`
  - `a_file_with_the_old_start_key_opens_to_the_same_path`
- `crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/exit_pick.rs`: `a_polygon_chain_is_left_at_the_exit_pick_and_passes_the_wire_laws`, `a_chain_cut_on_its_arcs_refuses_the_exit_pick_by_name`.
- `crates/app/tests/mcp_wire_contour.rs`: `edit_operation_sets_the_wire_exit_pick_and_refuses_one_it_cannot_hold`.
- `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/exit_tests.rs`: 5 unit tests of the module.
- Changed on purpose: `start_exit_shared::every_kind_has_one_pick_capability_and_only_the_taken_ones_take_a_pick` asserted that the wire refuses an exit. It now asserts that the wire takes it.

Red before the fix. On unchanged `upstream/main` (`98caf2dfd`), 5 of the 6 `wire_post::exit_pick` tests failed with:

```
invalid parameters: Wire Contour: a exit point is not taken - this kind takes a start point only; clear it on this operation
```

`a_file_with_the_old_start_key_opens_to_the_same_path` passed before the fix. PR #3871 already reads the old key. The test is the load test that the issue asks for, not a red pin.

Mutation results (one guard removed, pins run, guard restored, pins green again):

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `Threading` takes a start only (the old capability) | red: 5 `wire_post::exit_pick`, 2 `wire_dxf_selection::exit_pick`, the MCP pin, `start_exit_shared` |
| Door refusal of the pairs off | red: `each_exit_pick_the_wire_cannot_hold_is_refused_by_name`, the MCP pin |
| `generate_wire` ignores the exit pick (the old dispatch) | red: 5 `wire_post::exit_pick`, the polygon DXF pin, the MCP pin |
| Arcs refusal off | red: `a_chain_cut_on_its_arcs_refuses_the_exit_pick_by_name` |
| Tie guard off (motion) | red: `an_exit_pick_that_names_no_end_of_an_open_run_is_refused` |
| Exit side law off (motion) | red: `each_exit_pick_a_closed_profile_cannot_hold_is_refused_by_name` |
| Tabs guard off (motion) | red: the same test |
| On-path guard off (motion) | red: the same test |
| Open run never turned (motion) | red: `an_open_run_ends_at_the_end_nearest_the_exit_pick` |
| Closed ride skipped (motion) | red: `a_closed_profile_is_cut_all_the_way_round_and_left_at_the_exit_pick`, `the_ride_to_the_exit_follows_the_lap` |
| Generation guard of the pairs off (door still on) | **green: no pin** |

The last row is a guard without a pin. The command door refuses the pair first, at create, edit and load, so no command reaches the generation guard. It stays as a second guard, as `skims_refusal` does.

## Latest review fix

The latest review found that the Wire Contour Geometry tab hid a stated exit pick.
The tab now provides an Exit point group beside the Start point group.
The exit controls edit the draft. Apply commits the change through `EditOperationParams`.
Undo and redo use the existing command history.

Pin: `egui_app::start_exit_rows::tests::the_wire_geometry_tab_shows_the_start_hole_and_an_editable_exit`.
Mutation proof: Removing the `wire_exit_group` call made the pin fail (0 passed, 1 failed). Restoring the call made the pin pass (1 passed, 0 failed).

Final head: `ffa3e7ab3b1b6430aad50bacc28081918bb61cbd`.
Starting `upstream/main` ref: `d3c2bf0bae31f99809984032b2f778afeddf4d8a`.
The shared ref moved externally during checks to `c2875fcbd8d680d3652162cd45c318559da6aef0` (PR #3969).
The merge base stayed `ddee3aed6064eefe157110ab8923dbb02e1591ca`.
The 17-file triple-dot diff and the gate selections stayed the same.
The recorded program diff against the final ref is empty.
The checks were not rerun because the source and selections did not change.
These results do not claim a trial merge with the new main.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 59 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed for `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app`, and `camcraft-ui`, with `--all-targets -- -D warnings` (10m 56s).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` from `crates/ui`: 1640 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored; the pin passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: incomplete. The plan has 106 steps; 48 steps completed successfully. Step 49, `continuous_4axis_part`, waits for the release build lock.
- `app suites: example_catalog` and reached golden suites: `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored; `golden_cl`: 34 passed; `sodick_wire_passes`: 5 passed; `sodick_wire_post`: 8 passed; `solid_law_goldens`: 7 passed. The quick gate passed `wire_post` and `wire_dxf_selection`.

Before: ![Wire Contour Geometry before the fix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/9b6351d34ba7cd5fae17baa41922df33ca204d83/pr-3957/ffa3e7ab3-before.png)

After: ![Wire Contour Geometry after the fix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/9b6351d34ba7cd5fae17baa41922df33ca204d83/pr-3957/ffa3e7ab3-after.png)

The screenshots are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. No screenshot or review evidence is on this PR branch.

## Goldens moved

None. `git diff --stat upstream/main...HEAD -- "*.nc" "*.cl" examples/catalog` is empty.
On the final head, `example_catalog` passed 43 tests (4 ignored), and `golden_cl` passed 34 tests.
The final quick gate passed `wire_post` and `wire_dxf_selection`.
The extra golden suites also passed: `sodick_wire_passes` (5), `sodick_wire_post` (8), and `solid_law_goldens` (7).

## Not exercised

- Heavy lane limits: The full requested `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` did not finish. Of 106 planned steps, 48 completed successfully. Step 49, `continuous_4axis_part`, waits for a release build lock. An interrupted wrapper left a child gate. Its app library release build stopped producing output during the `ring` dependency for about six minutes, with no CPU activity. The PID namespace hides the lock owner, so this session cannot safely terminate it. No unexpected test failure was observed. The known-fail #1950 probes failed as expected, and the gate accepted those results. This run does not certify the full heavy gate as green.
- A real wire EDM control. The fixtures and conditions are synthetic.
- The generation guard of the refused pairs (see the mutation table).
- Viewport picking for the wire exit. The Geometry tab provides typed coordinates and Clear exit. The existing viewport picker is for 2D Contour only.
- An exit pick on a closed profile with a die and no capture. The slug law of the wire verify judges it as before.

## Overlaps

- PR #3617 (open, `conflicts`, `feat`) changes `cut_pass`, `wire_open`, `WireParams` and `wire_params`. This PR changes none of these functions. It touches the same files in other places: `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/mod.rs` (two lines in the module list and the `pub use` list) and `crates/app/src/operation/wire_op.rs` (`generate_wire` only). Touches the same file, different function; whichever merges second refreshes.
- This PR is not stacked on #3617. The head of #3617 is older than PR #3871, so it has no `picks` field to build on.
- #3617 adds `WireSide::Centre` and a closing overlap. After the two PRs merge, the exit pick and the closing overlap need one rule for the two together. The second PR to merge must add it.
- `crates/app/src/operation/wire_op.rs` was 496 lines on `main`. This PR adds 10 lines. A split of the file is not in this PR, because it overlaps #3617.

Changelog: Wire Contour takes an exit point: an open run ends at the end nearest the pick, and a closed profile is left at the pick after its full lap; a pick the wire cannot hold is refused by name.

Fixes #3332
